title: CTD: down counter
summary: CTD decrements CV on each rising edge of CD; LD loads PV into CV and Q is TRUE when CV <= 0.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.body:
- **LD** (load) copies **PV** into **CV**.
- Each rising edge of **CD** decrements CV by one.
- **Q** is TRUE while CV <= 0.

sections.heading: Typical use
sections.body: Counting down remaining parts in a batch or remaining attempts before a lockout.

instruction.state: Count value and previous CD state.
instruction.timing: One count per rising edge between calls.
